Definition: from G1722 and G3056 (in the sense of account); to reckon in, i.e. attribute:--impute, put on account.
BiblicalUsage: ellogéō is the word for impute, put on account. In Romans 5:13, the text says "but sin is not imputed when there is no law."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ellogéō as it stands: impute, put on account.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Fall; Onesimus Returns to Philemon
